BYes. A dedicated sending domain and IP guarantee inbox delivery.

CYes, as long as every send is marked transactional.

DAuthentication helps, but inbox placement also depends on engagement.

Correct answer: D. Authentication helps, but inbox placement also depends on engagement.

Authentication helps prove who sent a message, but it does not establish inbox placement. Providers also consider complaints, bounces, and how recipients engage.

Authentication can affect how providers handle email.

Authentication does not guarantee inbox placement.

The send classification controls opt-out handling, not inbox placement.

Question 5: Which list stores subscriber status across the whole Marketing Cloud account?

AThe data extension used for the latest campaign

BThe publication list most recently created

DThe suppression list used for the send classification

Correct answer: C. All Subscribers

All Subscribers stores account-level status. When someone unsubscribes, their record remains in the list with an unsubscribed status; it is not deleted.

A data extension stores an audience, not account-level subscriber status.

Publication Lists manage opt-outs for a category, not the whole account.

Suppression Lists contain addresses to leave out of a particular send.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Engagement Specialist (MC-202 / CRT-550 / Email Specialist) Guide
chunks.content:
Question 6: Which AMPscript function retrieves one value from a data extension for personalization?

Correct answer: A. Lookup

Lookup returns one field value from a data extension row that matches the criteria you provide.

DateAdd does date calculations.

Concat joins text values.

RaiseError stops the send for that subscriber and reports a problem.

Question 7: Why set a default value for personalization, such as with AMPscript conditions?

ATo bypass the send classification

BTo make the data extension smaller

CAvoid a blank greeting

DTo improve the sender reputation score

Correct answer: C. Avoid a blank greeting

Some records may not have the data you need. A default prevents a blank space in the email, such as a greeting with no name.

Send classification is separate from email content.

A default does not change the data stored in the data extension.

A default does not change sender reputation.

Question 8: What does a hard bounce mean?

AThe email address cannot receive mail permanently

BThe mailbox is temporarily full

CThe provider delayed the send

DThe subscriber reported the message as spam

Correct answer: A. The email address cannot receive mail permanently

A hard bounce means the address does not exist or has permanently rejected the email.

A full mailbox may cause a soft bounce.

Provider throttling delays delivery; it is not a bounce.

A spam complaint is different from a bounce.

Question 9: Which number can show that list hygiene is getting worse?

ANumber of data extensions in the account

BNumber of available templates

CTotal number of emails created

DBounce rate across several sends

Correct answer: D. Bounce rate across several sends

A rising bounce rate can show that the list has old or invalid addresses.

The number of data extensions does not measure list quality.

The number of templates does not affect delivery.

The number of emails created does not show whether the addresses are valid.

Question 10: Click-through rate for a send is measured against which number?

DAll subscribers in the account

Correct answer: C. Delivered emails

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Engagement Specialist (MC-202 / CRT-550 / Email Specialist) Guide
chunks.content:
Click-through rate is based on emails that reached recipients, so it uses delivered emails as the total.

Click-to-open rate uses opens; click-through rate uses delivered emails.

Sent email counts can include messages that bounced.

The account-wide subscriber count is not related to one send.

Question 11: What helps an A/B subject-line test produce a useful result?

ATest the smallest segment available

BRandomly split the audience and change only the subject line

CSend two very different emails to the same people

DSend version A one week and version B the next

Correct answer: B. Randomly split the audience and change only the subject line

Use randomly selected groups that are large enough, and change only one thing. Then you can tell whether the subject line caused the difference.

A very small group can produce results caused by chance.

If several things change, you cannot tell what caused the result.

Different send times can affect the result.

Question 12: What is one difference between a data extension and a subscriber list?

AA subscriber list supports more fields

BA data extension cannot be used for sends

CCustom columns and primary key

DThey are the same thing with different names

Correct answer: C. Custom columns and primary key

A data extension is a table that you define. Use it when you need custom fields or relationships.

Subscriber lists do not support more fields than data extensions.

Data extensions can be set up as sendable audiences.

They are different ways to store data.

Question 13: By default, what happens when someone unsubscribes through the standard profile center?

AThe sender profile for that business unit is changed

BThey are unsubscribed from All Subscribers across the account

CThey are removed from the data extension used for the send

DThey are unsubscribed from only that email

Correct answer: B. They are unsubscribed from All Subscribers across the account

If publication lists are not used, the unsubscribe is recorded in All Subscribers and applies across the account.

Sender profiles set the from address, not subscription status.

The unsubscribe status is stored on the subscriber record, not the send audience.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Engagement Specialist (MC-202 / CRT-550 / Email Specialist) Guide
chunks.content:
Unsubscribing from only one email is not the default behavior.

Question 14: Why does a sender profile matter for deliverability?

AIt sets how long tracking data is kept

BIt controls how many emails you can build

CIt stores subscriber preferences

DSet an authenticated from address

Correct answer: D. Set an authenticated from address

Receiving providers check the sending domain against published DNS records, so the from address should match the authenticated domain.

Tracking retention is a separate setting.

The sender profile does not set email creation limits.

Subscriber preferences are stored on the subscriber record.

Question 15: A send is scheduled, but many subscribers do not receive it. Tracking shows they were excluded before the send. What is the likely cause?

AThey are on a suppression list for the send

BThe subject line was too long

CThe send classification was transactional

DThe email template was too large

Correct answer: A. They are on a suppression list for the send

Suppression rules remove subscribers before sending, so they appear as excluded rather than bounced.

Subject length does not decide who receives the email.

The classification does not explain these pre-send exclusions.

Template size may affect display, not audience exclusions.

Question 16: Which practice can most directly reduce spam complaints over time?

ASend relevant content at a reasonable frequency

BUse a new sending domain for every campaign

DRemove the preference center link

Correct answer: A. Send relevant content at a reasonable frequency

People are less likely to complain when they have agreed to receive messages, the content is relevant, and the send frequency is reasonable.

Changing domains repeatedly can hurt reputation and may look suspicious.

Sending more to an uninterested audience can increase complaints.

Without a preference center, people may report the email as spam instead.

Energy and Utilities Cloud: Key Concepts

Energy & Utilities Cloud Data Model

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Energy & Utilities Cloud uses an industry data model to represent customers, billing relationships, premises, service points and equipment. A premise is the physical location. A service point is where a service is delivered to that premise; separate metered services can have separate service points. Accounts and billing accounts represent customer and payment relationships, while assets can represent installed meters or other equipment.

OmniStudio-Powered Customer Journeys

OmniStudio can support utility service journeys. An OmniScript can guide a customer or agent through starting service, moving, or reporting an outage. FlexCards can show useful context such as account details, bills, and service orders. Practise adapting the supplied components to a utility’s business rules.

Field Service Integration

A utility can use Field Service to plan and dispatch work such as meter installation, connection, or repair. Review how a service order relates to a work order and how scheduling assigns work to a crew. Mobile workers can receive jobs and record progress in the field.

Customer Portal and Self-Service

An Experience Cloud site can give customers a place to view billing information, request service changes, or report an outage. Knowledge articles can answer common questions. Plan the site around the services available to customers and the utility’s access and validation requirements.

Billing Integration and Account Management

A utility may keep billing in an external system such as SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B while using Salesforce for customer engagement. Decide which balances, usage details, and service requests must move between systems, how often to sync them, and how to handle errors or conflicting updates.

Salesforce Certified Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Practice Questions (With Explanations)

Test your knowledge with these 15 sample questions.

Answered: 0 / 15Correct: 0

Question 1: How should a utility model a customer relationship, the service location and separately metered connections?

AOne account for the customer and the service location

BStore the location as an account address

CCreate separate customer, premise and service-point records

DPut meter details in a contact note

Correct answer: C. Create separate customer, premise and service-point records

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Create separate customer, premise and service-point records is the best fit because the customer or billing account represents the commercial relationship; the premise represents the location, and a service point represents an individually metered service connection. These are related records with separate roles.

One account for the customer and the service location is not the best choice because one account does not represent the separate physical location and service connections.

Store the location as an account address is not the best choice because address fields alone do not model the relationship between premises and service points.

Put meter details in a contact note is not the best choice because a note cannot represent a service connection as a structured record.

Question 2: In the Energy & Utilities model, what does a service point identify?

AA billing account for the customer

BMetered connection at a premise

CThe premise address itself

DA reading from a billing period

Correct answer: B. Metered connection at a premise

Metered connection at a premise is the best fit because a service point is the entry point for a service at a premise; separately metered services are represented by distinct service points.

A billing account for the customer is not the best choice because the billing account represents the customer’s payment relationship.

The premise address itself is not the best choice because the premise is the physical location, not a service point.

A reading from a billing period is not the best choice because a reading records usage at a service point; it is not the service connection.

Question 3: When a new customer moves into an existing premise, which records and history should remain?

AReplace the premise with a new customer account

BRemove the service point and earlier readings

CLeave the old customer responsible for the new occupant’s bill

DKeep the premise and service history; update the customer and billing links

Correct answer: D. Keep the premise and service history; update the customer and billing links

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Keep the premise and service history; update the customer and billing links is the best fit because the premise remains the physical location, and the service point represents the service connection there. Move processes update the relevant customer and billing relationships while retaining service history.

Replace the premise with a new customer account is not the best choice because a customer move does not change the physical premise.

Remove the service point and earlier readings is not the best choice because deleting the service point would discard useful service and reading history.

Leave the old customer responsible for the new occupant’s bill is not the best choice because the previous customer should not be billed for the new occupant.

Question 4: What can interval usage data show that a monthly total cannot?

ABilling systems cannot accept a monthly total

BSalesforce cannot store monthly usage without custom code

CRegulators require every reading to be public within thirty days

DUsage timing can affect tariffs and demand charges

Correct answer: D. Usage timing can affect tariffs and demand charges

Usage timing can affect tariffs and demand charges is the best fit because time-of-use tariffs and demand charges depend on when energy was used, which a single monthly total cannot express.

Billing systems cannot accept a monthly total is not the best choice because monthly totals are processable; they are just less useful.

Salesforce cannot store monthly usage without custom code is not the best choice because monthly totals are perfectly storable; the issue is what they can tell you.

Regulators require every reading to be public within thirty days is not the best choice because publication of individual readings is not a general requirement.

Question 5: What should an agent review first when a customer disputes a meter reading?

ACredit the full bill and close the case

BReplace the meter before checking the complaint

CReview the service point’s reading history

DMove the customer to a cheaper tariff

Correct answer: C. Review the service point’s reading history

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Review the service point’s reading history is the best fit because the reading history shows whether the figure is consistent with past consumption, which is what tells you if there is a genuine problem.

Credit the full bill and close the case is not the best choice because crediting before investigating gives away revenue without establishing cause.

Replace the meter before checking the complaint is not the best choice because replacing hardware is expensive and premature before checking the data.

Move the customer to a cheaper tariff is not the best choice because changing tariff does not address whether the reading was correct.

Question 6: What information does a usage profile provide?

AThe customer’s typical consumption pattern

BA list of appliances at the premise

CA credit score for payment plans

DA record of the customer’s past complaints

Correct answer: A. The customer’s typical consumption pattern

The customer’s typical consumption pattern is the best fit because usage profiles describe expected consumption patterns, which support estimating, forecasting and spotting anomalies.

A list of appliances at the premise is not the best choice because appliance inventories are not what a usage profile is for.

A credit score for payment plans is not the best choice because credit assessment is a separate commercial process.

A record of the customer’s past complaints is not the best choice because complaint history is case management rather than usage.

Question 7: How can one commercial agreement cover service at twelve locations?

AOne contract with twelve sites described in free text

BTwelve contracts, one for each location

COne contract associated with twelve service points

DTwelve customer accounts with separate contract terms

Correct answer: C. One contract associated with twelve service points

One contract associated with twelve service points is the best fit because a contract can cover many service points, which is what lets a single commercial agreement span multiple sites.

One contract with twelve sites described in free text is not the best choice because addresses in free text cannot be billed or reported against.

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Twelve contracts, one for each location is not the best choice because separate contracts per site lose the single commercial agreement.

Twelve customer accounts with separate contract terms is not the best choice because splitting the customer into twelve accounts fragments the relationship.

Question 8: In a deregulated market, what choice may be available to the customer?

AWhether a customer can choose a supplier

BWhether Salesforce may store customer data

CWhether the utility provides only electricity

DWhether readings arrive monthly or quarterly

Correct answer: A. Whether a customer can choose a supplier

Whether a customer can choose a supplier is the best fit because deregulated markets let customers choose a retail supplier, which changes the processes a utility needs for switching and enrolment.

Whether Salesforce may store customer data is not the best choice because data residency is a separate legal question.

Whether the utility provides only electricity is not the best choice because the commodities supplied are unrelated to regulation.

Whether readings arrive monthly or quarterly is not the best choice because reading frequency is an operational choice, not the market structure.

Question 9: Which plan can spread expected annual charges across twelve monthly payments?

AA contract backdated to the financial year’s start

BAn extra service point for instalments

CMonthly credits against actual use

DA budget or levelised payment plan

Correct answer: D. A budget or levelised payment plan

A budget or levelised payment plan is the best fit because budget plans charge a level amount each month and reconcile against actual consumption periodically.

A contract backdated to the financial year’s start is not the best choice because backdating a contract does not change how the customer pays.

An extra service point for instalments is not the best choice because service points represent premises, not payment arrangements.

Monthly credits against actual use is not the best choice because monthly credit notes would misstate what the customer actually owes.

Question 10: Why connect Salesforce to a meter data management system?

AStore customer contact and marketing preferences

BManage validated meter readings

CGenerate every regulated customer invoice

DSchedule field technicians and vehicles

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Correct answer: B. Manage validated meter readings

Manage validated meter readings is the best fit because meter data management holds and validates the readings, so Salesforce consumes that data rather than owning it.

Store customer contact and marketing preferences is not the best choice because consent and preferences live with the customer record.

Generate every regulated customer invoice is not the best choice because invoicing is done by the billing system, not the meter data platform.

Schedule field technicians and vehicles is not the best choice because field resources are managed in field service.

Question 11: How can an agent view a customer’s usage, billing details and cases together?

AAgent console with customer context

BA weekly email with every agent’s open customers and cases

CA nightly spreadsheet extract agents can search

DSeparate browser tabs for each source system

Correct answer: A. Agent console with customer context

Agent console with customer context is the best fit because a console layout surfaces related records in context, which is what lets an agent answer a question without leaving the record.

A weekly email with every agent’s open customers and cases is not the best choice because a weekly report is stale by the time a customer calls.

A nightly spreadsheet extract agents can search is not the best choice because a spreadsheet extract is neither current nor auditable.

Separate browser tabs for each source system is not the best choice because switching between systems slows every call and invites mistakes.

Question 12: Why associate asset records with service points?

ATrack customer campaign responses

BRecord equipment installed at the premise

CStore tariff rates for service points

DKeep annual regulatory filings

Correct answer: B. Record equipment installed at the premise

Record equipment installed at the premise is the best fit because assets represent the physical equipment, such as meters, installed at a premise, which can be replaced while the premise stays the same.

Track customer campaign responses is not the best choice because campaign response belongs to marketing records.

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Store tariff rates for service points is not the best choice because tariffs are commercial terms, not physical equipment.

Keep annual regulatory filings is not the best choice because regulatory filings are documents, not installed assets.

Question 13: What is an efficient way to add service records for 400 new premises?

AOne service point for the entire development

BBulk-load the service-point records

CCreate each premise from an individual support case

DAsk the meter system to create Salesforce records

Correct answer: B. Bulk-load the service-point records

Bulk-load the service-point records is the best fit because each premise needs its own service point, and 400 of them is a data load rather than a manual task.

One service point for the entire development is not the best choice because one service point cannot represent 400 separately billed premises.

Create each premise from an individual support case is not the best choice because manual creation of 400 records is slow and inconsistent.

Ask the meter system to create Salesforce records is not the best choice because the meter data system does not own the Salesforce service point records.

Question 14: What does a utility work order normally describe?

AThe expected yearly usage pattern

BA monthly energy invoice

CA field job to be completed at a premise

DThe customer’s supply contract

Correct answer: C. A field job to be completed at a premise

A field job to be completed at a premise is the best fit because work orders capture jobs such as installations, reads and repairs, and link to the service point where the work happens.

The expected yearly usage pattern is not the best choice because expected consumption is a usage profile.

A monthly energy invoice is not the best choice because invoices are billing records.

The customer’s supply contract is not the best choice because contracts are commercial agreements.

Question 15: Why keep premise records separate from the people who occupy them?

APremise history survives customer moves

BAvoid connecting to the meter data system

CStop attaching tariffs to contracts

DReduce the number of records stored

chunks.title: Energy and Utilities Cloud Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Correct answer: A. Premise history survives customer moves

Premise history survives customer moves is the best fit because supply history belongs to the address, and occupiers come and go, so separating them is what keeps consumption history intact across moves.

Avoid connecting to the meter data system is not the best choice because a meter-data integration may still be needed for readings and usage history.

Stop attaching tariffs to contracts is not the best choice because tariffs can still be associated with the applicable commercial terms.

Reduce the number of records stored is not the best choice because record count is not the reason to separate a place from its changing occupants.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
Is the Experience Cloud Consultant Exam Hard?

The exam covers Experience Cloud site design, external-user licenses, sharing, content and administration. The right design depends on who will use the site and which records they need.

60 scored questions in 105 minutes, plus up to five unscored questions that do not count.

62% to pass, which is 38 correct answers out of 60.

Licensing-heavy: expect 6-8 questions on when to use Partner Community, Customer Community, and Customer Community Plus licenses.

Sharing model for external users: sharing sets, super user access, and sharing groups are heavily tested.

Build an Experience Cloud site in a Developer Edition org and test access as an external user. Practice explaining how the sharing options differ.

Experience Cloud Consultant Exam Format Explained

The exam is proctored online or at a test centre. Check Salesforce’s current exam guide for delivery details and requirements.

Multiple-choice & multiple-select

How Many Questions Are Scenario-Based?

Scenarios ask how to build a site for a particular audience. First identify the user type and license, then determine which content, records and site features that user needs.

Best Way to Pass on Your First Attempt

Start with the visitor type, their license and the records they need.

Choose a template and site features that match the audience’s task.

Compare Sharing Sets, partner sharing and guest access by their record-access rules.

Check the current Salesforce Help for license capabilities and site settings.

Experience Cloud Consultant: Key Concepts

Site Templates and Their Use Cases

Choose a site template based on the job it needs to do. Customer Service supports cases and knowledge; Partner Central supports partner processes such as deal registration. Help Center emphasizes knowledge, while Build Your Own offers more design flexibility. Compare the requirements before choosing a template.

Sharing Model for External Users

External-user access depends on the site’s license and sharing design. Sharing Sets can grant access to records related to the external user’s Account or Contact through configured mappings. Partner sharing options and guest-user access follow different rules. Choose the mechanism that matches the user type, record relationship and required access.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
User Licensing: Customer, Partner, and Guest Users

Experience Cloud sites support authenticated external users and unauthenticated guest access, subject to the site’s configuration and user licenses. License capabilities differ, so confirm the required objects, roles and sharing features before choosing a license.

Audience Targeting and Personalisation

Audiences group visitors by criteria such as login status or profile. You can use them to show different pages or components to different groups on the same site. Review how audience membership and page settings affect what each visitor sees.

Salesforce CMS and Knowledge for Content

Knowledge provides support articles, such as troubleshooting steps and FAQs, that visitors can search. Salesforce CMS manages content for delivery across channels, including site banners and other structured content. Practice choosing the tool that fits the content and audience.

License choice determines both cost and access model. Customer licenses use Sharing Sets tied to Account/Contact; Partner licenses use the full role hierarchy for deeper CRM access, this distinction drives most license-selection exam scenarios.

How to Pass the Salesforce Experience Cloud Consultant Exam

For each scenario, identify the visitor, login state, license and records that the site should expose.

Choose the user model first

Authenticated customers, partners and guest visitors have different license and access rules.

Match the sharing tool to the relationship

Sharing Sets use configured Account or Contact mappings. Partner and guest access use other controls.

Choose a site template by task

Case self-service, partner deal work and knowledge browsing may call for different templates.

Separate content from access

CMS manages content; sharing and permissions determine which records a user may access.

Preview visibility as each audience

Check component and page visibility for the intended audience before publishing.

Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant Practice Questions (With Explanations)

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
Answered: 0 / 20Correct: 0

Question 1: Which site template supports customer self-service for creating and following cases?

Correct answer: D. Customer Service

Customer Service is the best fit because the Customer Service template is optimised for self-service portals, it includes pre-built components for case creation, case tracking, Knowledge article search, and community discussion.

Build Your Own is not the best choice because 'Build Your Own' requires custom development, not the purpose-built self-service case template being asked about.

Partner Central is not the best choice because partner Central is designed for partner relationship management, not general customer self-service case tracking.

Help Center is not the best choice because help Center is more focused on knowledge/FAQ browsing than the case submission/tracking workflow described.

Question 2: How does Audience Targeting personalize an Experience Cloud site?

AConfigure sign-in and single sign-on

BShow tailored content to audience groups

CMeasure visitor traffic and engagement

DLimit the site to signed-in users

Correct answer: B. Show tailored content to audience groups

Show tailored content to audience groups is the best fit because audience Targeting lets site builders define audiences (e.g., Gold Partners, UK Customers) based on criteria, then assign specific pages, components, or content variations to each audience, enabling personalised experiences without building multiple sites.

Configure sign-in and single sign-on is not the best choice because managing authentication/SSO is a security configuration, unrelated to Audience Targeting's content-personalization purpose.

Measure visitor traffic and engagement is not the best choice because tracking visitor analytics is a reporting function, not what Audience Targeting does.

Limit the site to signed-in users is not the best choice because restricting access to authenticated users is a security/authentication concern, not what Audience Targeting does.

Question 3: Which sharing feature can grant external users access to records tied to their Account or Contact?

AManual record sharing

DExternal Account Hierarchy

Correct answer: C. Sharing Sets

Sharing Sets is the best fit because sharing Sets grant external users (Customer Community or Partner Community licence holders) access to records that match their Account or Contact via a defined access mapping, without requiring sharing rules or roles.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
Manual record sharing is not the best choice because manual Sharing is a one-off mechanism, not the systematic Account/Contact-based access mechanism being asked about.

Role hierarchy is not the best choice because role Hierarchy is an internal Salesforce access structure, not designed for external user access.

External Account Hierarchy is not the best choice because sharing Sets grant access based on criteria matching, not specifically Account/Contact relationship.

Question 4: What should a site present to help customers find answers before opening a case?

AClassify incoming cases with Einstein

BRoute emails into Salesforce

CUse Web-to-Case without Knowledge

DShow Knowledge before case submission

Correct answer: D. Show Knowledge before case submission

Show Knowledge before case submission is the best fit because case deflection presents Knowledge Articles to users before they submit a case, suggesting solutions that may resolve the issue without agent involvement. Knowledge must be enabled and articles published to the site for deflection to work.

Classify incoming cases with Einstein is not the best choice because einstein Case Classification routes cases after creation, it doesn't itself deflect cases from being created.

Route emails into Salesforce is not the best choice because email-to-Case with routing is about processing submitted cases, not deflecting them before submission.

Use Web-to-Case without Knowledge is not the best choice because web-to-Case captures cases from a public form, it doesn't deflect case creation through self-service.

Question 5: Which partner-site capability lets resellers submit and follow potential deals?

AOpportunity tracking

Correct answer: B. Deal Registration

Deal Registration is the best fit because deal Registration allows channel partners to claim credit for potential deals by registering them through the partner portal. It prevents channel conflict and ensures partners receive appropriate credit when a deal closes.

Opportunity tracking is not the best choice because 'Deal Registration' is the correct answer: Partner Relationship Management is the broader category, not the specific feature name being tested here.

Lead conversion is not the best choice because lead Conversion is a Sales Cloud process, unrelated to partner deal tracking.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
Partner management is not the best choice because opportunity Management alone is a general sales feature, not the partner-specific deal registration capability being asked about.

Question 6: Who can use an Experience Cloud site, including visitors who do not sign in?

AOnly signed-in members; guest visitors are never supported

BLicensed external members and permitted guest visitors

COnly internal Salesforce users

DOnly system administrators

Correct answer: B. Licensed external members and permitted guest visitors

Licensed external members and permitted guest visitors is the best fit because experience Cloud supports three user types: internal Salesforce users, external authenticated users (with Customer Community, Customer Community Plus, or Partner Community licences), and guest users who access the site without logging in. Each has different object and record access capabilities.

Only signed-in users; guests are unsupported is not the best choice because 'Only authenticated users' contradicts the fact that guest (unauthenticated) access is explicitly supported.

Only internal Salesforce users is not the best choice because restricting to internal full-license users is the opposite of Experience Cloud's purpose, which includes external users.

Only system administrators is not the best choice because restricting to System Administrator profile contradicts the fact that a broad range of external user types can access sites.

Question 7: What can an administrator configure with the Branding Editor?

AWrite CSS and JavaScript for every brand change

BReview visitor analytics and demographics

CSet colors, fonts and logos without code

DManage image files in Salesforce

Correct answer: C. Set colors, fonts and logos without code

Set colors, fonts and logos without code is the best fit because the Branding Editor within Experience Builder allows non-technical admins to apply a consistent brand by setting primary colours, background colours, text fonts, and button styles, all via point-and-click configuration.

Write CSS and JavaScript for every brand change is not the best choice because the Branding Editor is specifically a no-code declarative tool, it isn't a code editor.

Review visitor analytics and demographics is not the best choice because the Branding Editor controls visual branding, it isn't an analytics panel.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
Manage image files in Salesforce is not the best choice because the Branding Editor is for visual configuration, it isn't a file/asset management tool.

Question 8: Which Salesforce feature manages structured content for publication across channels?

CSalesforce Knowledge

Correct answer: D. Salesforce CMS

Salesforce CMS is the best fit because salesforce CMS is a headless content management system that enables content teams to create and publish structured content (news articles, product descriptions, banners) and deliver it to Experience Cloud sites, Marketing Cloud, and external channels via APIs.

Document Generation is not the best choice because chatter Groups are for collaboration, not structured multi-channel content publishing.

Chatter Groups is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as Salesforce CMS.

Salesforce Knowledge is not the best choice because salesforce Knowledge manages articles but isn't the cross-channel structured content management system being described.

Question 9: Where do administrators configure and manage Experience Cloud sites?

AA shared document space

BA customization sandbox

CExperience Cloud Workspaces

DA visitor analytics dashboard

Correct answer: C. Experience Cloud Workspaces

Experience Cloud Workspaces is the best fit because workspaces is the central administration area for Experience Cloud sites, accessible from Setup. It contains Experience Builder (visual page editor), Administration (members, login, security), Moderation, Analytics, and Content management panels.

A shared document space is not the best choice because a collaborative document workspace is a different concept, not what Experience Builder Workspaces provides.

A customization sandbox is not the best choice because a sandboxed testing environment is a different concept from the central admin management panel being described.

A visitor analytics dashboard is not the best choice because a reporting dashboard for traffic is a separate analytics feature, not what Experience Builder Workspaces provides.

Question 10: What does a Lightning Bolt Solution provide for an Experience Cloud implementation?

BAppExchange site package

CA live-chat component

DA native mobile-app builder

Correct answer: B. AppExchange site package

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
AppExchange site package is the best fit because lightning Bolt Solutions are pre-built site packages on AppExchange created by Salesforce ISV partners. They bundle a complete site template, including pages, themes, flows, and custom components; that can be installed and configured for rapid deployment.

A Slack integration is not the best choice because a Lightning Component adding chat is a specific component, not the broader packaged site template concept.

A live-chat component is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as An AppExchange package with reusable site elements.

A native mobile-app builder is not the best choice because a native mobile app accelerator is a different AppExchange offering, not what a Lightning Bolt Solution is.

Question 11: Where are permissions for unauthenticated site visitors controlled?

AThe Minimum Access profile alone

BWorkspaces settings alone

CGuest User profile and sharing

DThe profile shared with signed-in users

Correct answer: C. Guest User profile and sharing

Guest User profile and sharing is the best fit because each Experience Cloud site has a dedicated Guest User profile. Admins control which objects guest users can read, which fields are visible, and which records they can access via guest user sharing rules. Salesforce has tightened guest user security in recent releases, the exam tests which access types require authentication.

The Minimum Access profile alone is not the best choice because guest user access isn't managed exclusively through Workspaces settings, it's controlled via the dedicated Guest User profile and sharing rules.

Workspaces settings alone is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as The site’s dedicated Guest User profile and sharing setup.

The profile shared with signed-in users is not the best choice because guest users don't share the same profile as authenticated users; they have a distinct Guest User profile.

Question 12: How can a site display different components to members and guest visitors?

AProfile-based page assignments

DAudience visibility rules

Correct answer: D. Audience visibility rules

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
Audience visibility rules is the best fit because audience-Based Visibility in Experience Builder allows admins to define when a component or page is visible, such as showing a login prompt to guests and a personalised dashboard to authenticated members. Audiences can be based on login status, user attributes, or record data.

Profile-based page assignments is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as Audience-based component or page visibility.

Record page layouts is not the best choice because record Detail Page Layouts control field display on records, not member-vs-guest content differentiation.

Site.com Studio is not the best choice because site.com Studio is a legacy tool, not the current Experience Cloud mechanism for audience-based content visibility.

Question 13: What must be configured so partner users can update the Opportunities they are allowed to access?

ACopy partner updates into Opportunities with a custom Apex trigger

BGive partners internal CRM licenses

CExpose Opportunities to unauthenticated visitors

DAssign a partner license and share the target Opportunities

Correct answer: D. Assign a partner license and share the target Opportunities

Assign a partner license and share the target Opportunities is the best fit because partner Community licences enable external partner users to access Salesforce objects including Opportunities. Sharing must be configured, via sharing rules, sharing sets, or External Account Hierarchy, to grant access to the specific records. Guest user access cannot be used for write operations on CRM records.

Copy portal updates with a custom Apex trigger is not the best choice because a custom Apex trigger for syncing is unnecessary, native sharing configuration already provides this access.

Give partners internal CRM licenses is not the best choice because giving partners full internal CRM licenses is costly and unnecessary: Partner Community licenses are the purpose-built solution.

Expose Opportunities to unauthenticated visitors is not the best choice because enabling guest user access would expose Opportunity data to unauthenticated visitors, which is inappropriate for this scenario.

Question 14: How can site members access reports and dashboards for their data?

ACRM Analytics dashboards embedded in an iframe

BReports and dashboards with sharing

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
CChatter engagement metrics

DCMS publishing metrics

Correct answer: B. Reports and dashboards with sharing

Reports and dashboards with sharing is the best fit because standard Salesforce Reports and Dashboards can be made accessible in Experience Cloud sites by adding the Reports tab and configuring sharing so external users see only their own data. For more advanced analytics, CRM Analytics can be embedded within site pages.

CRM Analytics in an iframe only is not the best choice because chatter Feed analytics tracks post engagement, not general business reporting.

Chatter engagement metrics is not the best choice because salesforce CMS publishing metrics track content performance, not general business reports/dashboards.

CMS publishing metrics is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as External-user access to Reports and Dashboards, with sharing configured.

Question 15: What access pattern do Sharing Sets use for external users?

ASet site colors, logos and other visual branding

BShare Salesforce Files with authenticated internal employees

CMatch records to an external user’s Account or Contact

DGrant site members access to available reports and dashboards

Correct answer: C. Match records to an external user’s Account or Contact

Match records to an external user’s Account or Contact is the best fit because Sharing Sets use configured Account or Contact mappings to grant external-user record access.

Set site colors, logos and other visual branding is not the best choice because branding changes appearance, not record access.

Share Salesforce Files with authenticated internal employees is not the best choice because internal file sharing does not grant external users access to related records.

Grant site members access to available reports and dashboards is not the best choice because dashboard access does not control which underlying records an external user can access.

Question 16: A company wants prospective customers to create their own portal account without an admin manually adding each one. What should the consultant configure?

AA self-registration page for the site

BManually create a new Contact for every visitor

CDisable all guest access

DA single shared login for every customer

Correct answer: A. A self-registration page for the site

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
A self-registration page lets prospects create their own account, which then creates the underlying Contact and User automatically, without manual admin work per person.

Manually creating a Contact for every visitor doesn't scale and defeats the purpose of self-service signup.

Disabling guest access would prevent anyone from reaching the registration page in the first place.

A single shared login would prevent tracking individual customers and their own data access.

Question 17: A company wants employees to sign into an Experience Cloud site using their existing corporate identity provider credentials, not a separate Salesforce password. What should the consultant set up?

AAn authentication provider or SSO configuration for the site

BA stricter password policy applied to the site's member profile

CA sharing set that grants access to related records

Correct answer: A. An authentication provider or SSO configuration for the site

Configuring an authentication provider or SSO lets users log in with their existing corporate identity provider credentials instead of a separate Salesforce-specific login.

A password policy still relies on a separate Salesforce login, it doesn't enable SSO with an external identity provider.

A Sharing Set controls record access, it has nothing to do with how a user authenticates.

A Content Workspace organizes CMS content, unrelated to authentication.

Question 18: A client wants a highly specific, non-standard interaction on their site that no out-of-the-box Experience Builder component supports. What should the consultant consider, and what should they check first?

AA custom Lightning web component, after confirming it fits within Experience Cloud's customization limits

BImmediately promise it's impossible

CA full rebuild of the site on another platform, after confirming the budget with the client's sponsor

DIgnore the requirement

Correct answer: A. A custom Lightning web component, after confirming it fits within Experience Cloud's customization limits

Custom LWCs can extend Experience Builder beyond standard components, but a consultant should first check documented customization considerations and limitations before committing to a design.

Declaring it impossible without checking custom component options skips a real, available solution.

Rebuilding outside Salesforce abandons the platform unnecessarily for a solvable requirement.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Study Guide & Practice Questions
chunks.content:
Ignoring a stated requirement isn't a valid consulting response.

Question 19: A site owner wants to see how many members are actively logging in and engaging with content each month. What should they review?

AExperience Cloud site analytics and dashboards

BThe Branding Editor's theme and colour settings panel

DA Content Type definition

Correct answer: A. Experience Cloud site analytics and dashboards

Site analytics and dashboards track member login and engagement trends, which is exactly what Adoption and Analytics covers.

The Branding Editor controls visual appearance, not engagement tracking.

A Sharing Set controls record access, not usage analytics.

A Content Type defines a kind of CMS content, it doesn't report on member activity.

Question 20: A business wants a lightweight, simple landing page experience rather than a full-featured portal with cases and knowledge. Which template type best fits?

BCustomer Service (Napili)

Correct answer: A. Microsite

A Microsite template is designed for lightweight landing pages, not the full case-and-knowledge feature set of a support-focused template.

Customer Service (Napili) is built around case deflection and support, more than a simple landing page needs.

Partner Central is designed for partner relationship management, not a simple public landing page.

Help Centre is a self-service knowledge template, heavier than a simple landing page requirement.

Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) Exam FAQs

What is covered on the Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) exam?

The Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant (CRT-271) exam has 8 sections. Administration, Setup, and Configuration (25%), Sharing, Visibility, and Licensing (17%), and Branding, Personalization, and Content (15%) together make up 57% of the exam. The full section-by-section weightage is in the table on this page.

What is Experience Cloud (formerly Community Cloud)?

Experience Cloud allows you to create branded portals for customers, partners, or employees. It enables self-service, collaboration, and engagement outside your main Salesforce org.

Do I need Platform Administrator before Experience Cloud Consultant?

Yes, Platform Administrator is required. You should also have hands-on experience configuring Experience Cloud sites, sharing sets, audiences, and community features.

What is the Experience Cloud Consultant passing score and exam fee in Summer '26?

The Experience Cloud Consultant exam has 60 multiple-choice questions, 105 minutes, and a passing score of 62%. The exam fee is $200 USD (retake $100 USD), and the Platform Administrator certification is a prerequisite. Up to five unscored questions may be added.

What types of Experience Cloud sites are covered in the exam?

The exam covers Customer Community, Partner Community, and Employee Community site types, plus the differences between Lightning template-based sites and Salesforce Tabs + Visualforce sites. Expect questions on digital experiences for portals, self-service, and partner relationship management (PRM).

Field Service Consultant: Key Concepts

Core records and relationships

A Work Order describes the work to be done. Work Order Line Items break that work into tasks. A Service Appointment represents the planned visit, and a Service Resource is the person, crew or equipment assigned to it. Assets identify customer equipment. Follow the links between the Case, Work Order, appointment and assigned resource.

Scheduling and dispatch

Dispatchers use the Dispatcher Console and its Gantt view to review and assign appointments. A Scheduling Policy gives the scheduler rules and objectives. The scheduler can weigh requirements such as skills, territory, availability and travel. Manual assignment and automated optimization are different ways to schedule work.

Territories, resources and skills

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide

A Service Territory groups work by a geographic or logical area. Service Territory Members connect resources to territories for a period of time. Skills and required skill levels help determine whether a resource is qualified. Check these records along with availability when diagnosing an assignment.

The Field Service mobile app lets technicians review assigned work and update records from a mobile device. Offline behavior depends on the configured mobile app and its data settings. Confirm which records and actions must be available without a connection.

Product Required records describe parts planned for a Work Order. Product Consumed records track parts actually used. Compare planned and actual quantities when reconciling a job. Inventory locations and transfers support the movement of stock.

A Work Order (built from a Work Type template) has one or more child Service Appointments. Each appointment is scheduled to a Service Resource whose Skills and Territory Membership the optimizer checks before assignment.

Test your knowledge with these 20 sample questions. Use these practice items to review the stated scenarios. They are not actual or recalled exam questions; check the answers against current Salesforce Help.

Question 1: Which Field Service record represents a worker or other resource that can receive an assignment?

AA booked customer visit

BA geographic service area

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
CA schedule of working times

Correct answer: D. Service Resource

Service Resource is the best fit because a Service Resource represents a person or other resource used in field operations. Availability is affected by related configuration and is not simply a property of the record alone.

A booked customer visit is not the best choice because service Appointment represents scheduled work, not technician availability itself.

A geographic service area is not the best choice because service Territory defines a geographic/logical area, not individual technician availability.

A schedule of working times is not the best choice because operating Hours define when a resource/location is generally open, but Service Resource specifically represents the technician's availability record.

Question 2: What does a Field Service Scheduling Policy tell the optimizer?

AAssign each worker to a territory

BTrack all scheduled customer visits

CScheduling Policy rules and objectives

DManage inventory for every service location

Correct answer: C. Scheduling Policy rules and objectives

Scheduling Policy rules and objectives is the best fit because scheduling Policies define work rules (constraints) and objectives that the scheduling optimizer uses when assigning appointments.

Assign each worker to a territory is not the best choice because assigning resources to territories is a separate configuration, not what a Scheduling Policy defines.

Track all scheduled customer visits is not the best choice because tracking service appointments is a record-management function, not what a Scheduling Policy defines.

Manage inventory for every service location is not the best choice because managing parts inventory is a separate Field Service function, unrelated to Scheduling Policy's optimizer rules.

Question 3: Which tool lets technicians review schedules and update work while offline?

AService Console for desktop agents

BField Service Mobile

CLightning Experience for office users

DDispatcher Console for dispatchers

Correct answer: B. Field Service Mobile

Field Service Mobile is the best fit because the Field Service Mobile App allows technicians to access schedules, update work orders, and capture signatures even without internet connectivity.

Service Console for desktop agents is not the best choice because service Console is a general Salesforce interface, not the mobile offline-capable app for technicians.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
Lightning Experience for office users is not the best choice because lightning Experience is the general desktop interface, not the mobile offline app for field technicians.

Dispatcher Console for dispatchers is not the best choice because dispatcher Console is used by dispatchers in the office, not by field technicians in the field.

Question 4: Which details determine whether a technician qualifies for an appointment?

AThe technician’s Salesforce profile

BPermission sets assigned to the technician

CThe technician’s place in the role hierarchy

DSkills and territory membership

Correct answer: D. Skills and territory membership

Skills and territory membership is the best fit because skill Requirements on the Work Type and Service Territory membership determine which Service Resources are eligible for scheduling.

The technician’s Salesforce profile is not the best choice because user Profile alone controls broad access, not the specific scheduling eligibility criteria.

Permission sets assigned to the technician is not the best choice because permission Sets grant feature access, not specifically scheduling eligibility.

The technician’s place in the role hierarchy is not the best choice because role Hierarchy determines record visibility, not specifically technician scheduling eligibility.

Question 5: Where can a dispatcher see appointments plotted across a timeline?

AA calendar list showing appointment dates

BA record list sorted by appointment time

CA territory map showing service locations

DDispatcher Console Gantt

Correct answer: D. Dispatcher Console Gantt

Dispatcher Console Gantt is the best fit because the Dispatcher Console Gantt shows a visual timeline of scheduled appointments across service resources.

A calendar list showing appointment dates is not the best choice because calendar View shows a different, less operationally detailed schedule view.

A record list sorted by appointment time is not the best choice because list View shows tabular data, not the visual timeline dispatchers use.

A territory map showing service locations is not the best choice because map View shows geographic location, not the visual scheduling timeline being described.

Question 6: What setup record provides default work-order details such as duration, skills and parts?

ATrack inventory without linking it to a job

BChoose the service territory for every customer

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
DBuild reports about completed jobs

Correct answer: C. Work Type

Work Type is the best fit because work Type defines the template for work orders including duration and skill requirements.

Track inventory without linking it to a job is not the best choice because 'To track inventory only' misattributes Work Type's purpose to a different Field Service function.

Choose the service territory for every customer is not the best choice because assigning territories is a separate configuration, unrelated to Work Type's template purpose.

Build reports about completed jobs is not the best choice because creating reports is a separate function, unrelated to Work Type's template purpose.

Question 7: How is a scheduled Service Appointment related to its Work Order?

AA Service Resource assigned to the job

BService Appointment under its Work Order

COperating Hours linked to the territory

DA Service Territory linked to the customer

Correct answer: B. Service Appointment under its Work Order

Service Appointment under its Work Order is the best fit because service Appointments are child records of Work Orders.

A Service Resource assigned to the job is not the best choice because service Resource represents the technician, not the object linking appointment to work order.

Operating Hours linked to the territory is not the best choice because operating Hours define availability windows, not the appointment-to-work-order link.

A Service Territory linked to the customer is not the best choice because service Territory defines a geographic area, not the appointment-to-work-order link.

Question 8: Which factors can the optimizer use when it assigns an appointment?

AThe territory by itself, without resource details

BSkills, time, travel and policy

CSkills alone, regardless of availability

DTravel time alone, regardless of job requirements

Correct answer: B. Skills, time, travel and policy

Skills, time, travel and policy is the best fit because the optimizer considers skills, availability, travel, and policies.

The territory by itself, without resource details is not the best choice because 'Only territory' undersells the optimizer's broader consideration of skills, travel time, and policies.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
Skills alone, regardless of availability is not the best choice because 'Only skills' undersells the optimizer's broader consideration of availability, travel time, and policies.

Travel time alone, regardless of job requirements is not the best choice because 'Only travel time' undersells the optimizer's broader consideration of skills, availability, and policies.

Question 9: Which dispatcher view supports manual appointment drag-and-drop?

AA list view used to edit records

BDispatcher Console Gantt

CA map view used to locate service addresses

DA report used to summarize appointment history

Correct answer: B. Dispatcher Console Gantt

Dispatcher Console Gantt is the best fit because the Gantt allows manual drag-and-drop scheduling.

A list view used to edit records is not the best choice because list View alone doesn't support drag-and-drop scheduling, that's the Gantt's specific function.

A map view used to locate service addresses is not the best choice because map View alone doesn't support drag-and-drop scheduling, that's the Gantt's specific function.

A report used to summarize appointment history is not the best choice because reports display data, they don't support interactive drag-and-drop scheduling.

Question 10: What availability windows can Operating Hours define?

ADefine skill requirements for each worker

BRecord which parts are in the van

CResource and location availability windows

DCreate work orders for new jobs

Correct answer: C. Resource and location availability windows

Resource and location availability windows is the best fit because operating Hours define availability windows for resources and locations.

Define skill requirements for each worker is not the best choice because 'To define skills only' undersells Operating Hours, which is about availability windows, not skills.

Record which parts are in the van is not the best choice because 'To track parts only' misattributes Operating Hours' purpose to a different Field Service function.

Create work orders for new jobs is not the best choice because 'To create work orders' misattributes Operating Hours' purpose to a different Field Service function.

Question 11: Which records track parts planned for or used on work orders?

AService Resource records for each worker

BWork Type records for common job templates

CProduct Required / Product Consumed

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
DService Territory records for dispatch areas

Correct answer: C. Product Required / Product Consumed

Product Required / Product Consumed is the best fit because product Required and Product Consumed track parts on work orders.

Service Resource records for each worker is not the best choice because service Resource represents the technician, not the parts-tracking object.

Work Type records for common job templates is not the best choice because work Type defines the job template, not the specific parts-tracking object.

Service Territory records for dispatch areas is not the best choice because service Territory defines a geographic area, unrelated to tracking parts.

Question 12: Which tasks can technicians complete in the Field Service mobile app?

AView the schedule only while online

BRun reports but not update service records

COffline work, signatures and photos

DView dashboards without appointment details

Correct answer: C. Offline work, signatures and photos

Offline work, signatures and photos is the best fit because the mobile app supports offline work, signatures, and photos.

View the schedule only while online is not the best choice because 'Online only' is the opposite of what the mobile app's offline capability provides.

Run reports but not update service records is not the best choice because 'Reports only' undersells the mobile app's broader field capabilities (offline, signatures, photos).

View dashboards without appointment details is not the best choice because 'Dashboards only' undersells the mobile app's broader field capabilities (offline, signatures, photos).

Question 13: What enables the system to assign appointments automatically using optimization rules?

AManual assignment by a dispatcher only

BThe Gantt display with no scheduling service

CA map that only shows service locations

DOptimization with Scheduling Policies

Correct answer: D. Optimization with Scheduling Policies

Optimization with Scheduling Policies is the best fit because the optimization service runs with scheduling policies for automatic assignment.

Manual assignment by a dispatcher only is not the best choice because manual assignment is the opposite of the automated optimization being asked about.

The Gantt display with no scheduling service is not the best choice because gantt alone is a visualization tool, not the automated scheduling engine itself.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
A map that only shows service locations is not the best choice because map View alone is a visualization tool, not the automated scheduling engine itself.

Question 14: How does a Service Territory help organize field work?

ATrack parts without identifying a work area

BGeographic or logical service areas

CCreate standard job templates for each customer

DRecord service contracts and billing terms

Correct answer: B. Geographic or logical service areas

Geographic or logical service areas is the best fit because service Territories define areas for resource assignment and routing.

Track parts without identifying a work area is not the best choice because 'To track parts only' misattributes Service Territory's purpose to a different Field Service function.

Create standard job templates for each customer is not the best choice because 'To create work types only' misattributes Service Territory's purpose to a different Field Service function.

Record service contracts and billing terms is not the best choice because 'To manage contracts only' misattributes Service Territory's purpose to a different Field Service function.

Question 15: Which Field Service features represent covered services and service-level commitments?

AWork Types to define expected job details

BOperating Hours to set availability windows

CService Resources to list assigned workers

DService Contracts and Entitlements

Correct answer: D. Service Contracts and Entitlements

Service Contracts and Entitlements is the best fit because service Contracts and Entitlements define SLAs and covered services.

Work Types to define expected job details is not the best choice because work Type alone defines job templates, not entitlement/SLA tracking.

Operating Hours to set availability windows is not the best choice because operating Hours alone define availability windows, not entitlement/SLA tracking.

Service Resources to list assigned workers is not the best choice because service Resource alone represents technicians, not entitlement/SLA tracking.

Question 16: A dispatcher wants certain field technicians to see only the scheduled appointments assigned to their own crew, not every appointment in the org. What should the consultant configure?

ASharing rules or settings that scope Service Appointment visibility to the resource's crew

BA new Work Type for each crew

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
CA different Operating Hours record for each technician, with a separate Service Territory per crew

DA Maintenance Plan per crew

Correct answer: A. Sharing rules or settings that scope Service Appointment visibility to the resource's crew

Sharing Service Appointments appropriately, scoped to a resource's crew or territory, is exactly what the Permissions and Sharing domain covers.

A new Work Type defines job templates, it doesn't control who can see which appointments.

Operating Hours define availability windows, not record visibility.

A Maintenance Plan schedules preventive work, it doesn't control appointment sharing.

Question 17: Equipment at a customer site needs preventive service visits generated automatically on a recurring schedule. What should the consultant set up?

AA Maintenance Plan linked to the Asset

BA one-off Work Order with no recurrence

Correct answer: A. A Maintenance Plan linked to the Asset

A Maintenance Plan linked to an Asset generates Work Orders on a recurring schedule for preventive maintenance, exactly what's needed here.

A one-off Work Order doesn't recur automatically, it's a single job.

A Service Territory organizes field work geographically, it doesn't generate recurring visits.

A Schedule Policy guides the optimizer's scheduling rules, it doesn't create the recurring work itself.

Question 18: A part is installed on a customer's equipment during a service visit. How should the consultant track which part now belongs to that equipment?

AUpdate the Asset record and its relationship to the Product Consumed

BDelete the old Asset record

CIgnore it, parts aren't tracked after installation

DCreate a new Work Order for the visit with no reference to the installed part

Correct answer: A. Update the Asset record and its relationship to the Product Consumed

Managing Assets includes updating Asset records and their relationships when parts are installed, so the system reflects what's actually on the customer's equipment.

Deleting the Asset record would lose the equipment's service history.

Parts used in service visits are specifically tracked through Products Consumed and Asset relationships.

A Work Order with no part reference wouldn't document what was installed.

chunks.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Field Service and Operations Consultant (FS-Con-101) Study Guide
chunks.content:
Question 19: A technician's van needs to carry the right parts for scheduled jobs, and the dispatcher wants to know what stock is on that van. What supports this?

AA van as a Service Resource with an associated Product Inventory location

CAn Operating Hours record that lists the days the van is in use by each technician

Correct answer: A. A van as a Service Resource with an associated Product Inventory location

Modeling a van as a Service Resource (or linked location) with Product Inventory tracks what stock is available on that van, part of the Managing Inventory domain.

A Work Type defines job templates, not inventory locations.

Operating Hours define availability, not stock tracking.

A Schedule Policy guides the optimizer, it doesn't track van inventory.

Question 20: A field service mobile user needs to capture a customer's signature confirming work is complete. What supports this?

ACustomer sign-off configured in the Field Service mobile app

BA desktop-only report

DA Service Territory member record with the customer's name added to it

Correct answer: A. Customer sign-off configured in the Field Service mobile app

Customer sign-off is a Field Service mobile app capability that lets a technician capture a signature confirming completed work, part of Configuring Mobility.

A desktop-only report doesn't work in the field where the technician needs to capture a signature on-site.

Operating Hours define availability, unrelated to signature capture.

A Service Territory member record defines territory assignment, not sign-off capture.

Financial Services Cloud: Key Concepts

FSC Data Model: Households, Individuals, and Financial Accounts

Financial Services Cloud adds financial records and relationship features to Salesforce. Financial Accounts represent accounts such as deposits or investments; Financial Account Roles connect people to those accounts and describe their roles. Financial Holdings can represent positions within investment accounts. Assets, liabilities and goals capture other parts of a client’s financial picture. Household and rollup behavior depends on the configured data model and rollup settings.

Relationship Management and Referrals

Households and other relationship groups help advisers understand connected clients. Contact-to-contact relationships link people, while account-to-account relationships link businesses. Referrals can route a client need to another employee or team. Use the relationship type that matches the parties involved.

Action Plans for Client Lifecycle Management

An action plan turns a template into a repeatable set of tasks, such as client onboarding. Tasks can have due dates and assignments, and the plan can be linked to records such as accounts or opportunities. Teams can follow progress as the work is completed.

Rollup Summaries and Financial Aggregations

Heroku Architect: Key Concepts

Heroku Platform Architecture & Dynos

Heroku apps run in dynos. Web dynos handle HTTP requests, worker dynos run background jobs, and one-off dynos run administrative tasks. Dyno filesystems are ephemeral, so persistent files belong in a database or object store. Heroku’s router imposes a request time limit, so move long-running work to an asynchronous job. Scale an app by adding dynos or selecting a larger dyno type, as supported by the plan.

Data Services: Heroku Postgres & Redis

Heroku Postgres supports followers for read workloads and high-availability options on eligible plans. A follower is read-only. Connection pooling can reduce the number of database connections used by app processes. Heroku Key-Value Store provides Redis-compatible storage for caching and other fast key-value needs. Check current product availability and plan limits before selecting a service.

CI/CD, Review Apps & Release Management

A pipeline helps a team promote a tested build from one stage to another, such as staging to production. Review apps provide temporary environments for pull requests, and Heroku CI can run tests. Review how buildpacks or container images produce a release, how config vars hold environment-specific settings, and how the release phase runs tasks such as migrations before a release is deployed. Practise rolling back when a release fails.

Security, Compliance & Private Spaces

Architecture Patterns for Salesforce + Heroku

Heroku Connect can synchronize Salesforce data and Heroku Postgres. For event-driven integration, compare Platform Events with Change Data Capture. For direct requests, review the Salesforce REST API, Heroku AppLink, and External Services. Choose a pattern based on data volume, consistency, access, and the system that owns the data.

Heroku Connect maps Salesforce objects to Postgres tables and polls both sides on a schedule (or via streaming), writing changes in whichever direction is configured; this lets a Heroku app read/write Salesforce data without direct API calls.

chunks.title: Heroku Developer Accredited Professional Study Guide & Practice Questions (Retiring Feb 2027)
chunks.content:
Buildpacks, Runtime & Procfile

A buildpack turns supported source code into a slug; container deployments use an image instead. A Procfile can define process types such as web, worker and release. The web process must listen on the port provided in the PORT environment variable. A release command runs before the new release’s dynos start, and a failure prevents that release from being activated.

Config Vars, Add-ons & Environment Management

Config vars hold environment-specific settings and secrets. Updating one restarts the app with the new value. Add-ons provide managed services, such as a database or logging, and may supply their own config vars. Separate staging and production apps in a pipeline so each can have its own settings and services.

Heroku Connect & Salesforce Integration

Heroku Connect maps Salesforce objects and fields to Heroku Postgres tables. A read-only mapping sends Salesforce changes to Postgres; a read-write mapping can also send changes back. Synchronization can be delayed. An app can use the Salesforce REST API with OAuth when it needs a direct request instead.

Async Jobs, Workers & Message Queues

Move slow work out of a web request and into a worker dyno. The web process can place a job on a queue for the worker to process. Heroku Scheduler can start one-off dynos for scheduled jobs, and Apache Kafka on Heroku can support event streams. Make jobs safe to retry after interruptions.

Monitoring, Logging & Performance

Heroku combines router, dyno, and add-on logs through Logplex. Inspect them with `heroku logs --tail` or send them to another service with a log drain. Learn common errors such as H10 and H12, then use metrics to investigate load and memory. You can scale by adding dynos or selecting a larger dyno type.
